responsibilities: Insights & Analytics ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.    ZS is seeking a Decision Analytics Associate to join the Supply Chain and Manufacturing practice, with a focus on pharmaceutical CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) drug development. This role is designed for professionals with 2–3 years of hands-on pharmaceutical experience who are ready to apply their domain expertise and quantitative modeling skills to digitalize and analytically transform CMC operations for global pharma clients. You will support project delivery, contribute to CMC data and analytics solution development, and grow your consulting skillset within a collaborative, high-impact team. What You’ll Do Leverage quantitative skills to derive answers to clients' ongoing business analytics and reporting questions Work collaboratively with clients to ascertain the client's specific business information needs Upskill on concepts relevant to solve client problems across modalities Execute a specific plan for analyzing the data necessary to secure solutions to clients' particular business information need(s) Discuss and determine with clients which specific data may be best utilized in order to perform the necessary analysis Evaluate, assess and analyze the data necessary to provide solutions to the client's particular business information needs Communicate the data results to the client, with an emphasis on answering the business question as opposed to the analytical and reporting processes used Gain immediate familiarity with client's internal processes Develop expertise within a client analytics area Be available for clients during regular working hours Build/use first-principles models (e.g., CFD, DEM) to simulate and optimize pharmaceutical manufacturing unit operations such as blending, granulation, coating, drying, and tableting Develop/use AI/ML models for predictive analytics, process optimization, and quality prediction across CMC workflows — including CQA prediction, CPP sensitivity analysis, and batch outcome forecasting Translate model outputs into actionable client insights to support process development, scale-up, and tech transfer decisions Support model validation, verification, and documentation aligned with Quality by Design (QbD) principles and regulatory expectations (e.g., ICH Q8/Q9/Q10) Collaborate with cross-functional client teams (Formulation, Process Engineering, Quality, Regulatory) to identify and prioritize modeling opportunities across drug substance and drug product development Advance problem-solving skills and improve ZS’s capabilities; Guide and mentor Associates on teams. What You’ll Bring Bachelor's (and often graduate) degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Chemistry, Biotechnology or similar degree 1+ years of experience working in a pharmaceutical CMC organization Hands-on experience building/using first-principles (e.g., CFD, DEM) and AI/ML models for pharma process development for at least one modality Experience developing and managing production-grade codes for models, including models' lifecycle management Knowledge of key concepts including unit operations, processes, Quality by Design (QbD), tech transfer, process validation, quality attributes, and regulatory milestones across pharma development Ability to translate the knowledge of concepts in one modality to other modalities, if needed Understanding of the different data and information systems such as ELN, LIMS, ERP systems, and LCM or PLM systems Optional: Understanding of the CMC related regulatory submission requirements Experience presenting to senior leaders, executives, and audiences with CMC backgrounds Ability to lead multiple workstreams and demonstrate effective time and project management skills Capability to simplify complex concepts into easily understandable frameworks and presentations Proficiency in working within a virtual global team environment, contributing to the timely delivery of multiple projects Travel to other offices as required to collaborate with clients and internal project teams Fluency in English. Client-first mentality. Intense work ethic. Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

Proven track record leading end‑to‑end CRM/PRM implementations, preferably on Salesforce Health Cloud or Life Sciences Cloud. Strong background in life science/pharma essential. Experience and exposure to pharma patient services is preferable. This includes HUB operations, reimbursement, specialty therapies, oncology, or rare disease programs. Demonstrated experience managing large, diverse teams, including contractors and specialized techno‑functional roles. Proven ability to sell, scope, and grow new programs with senior client stakeholders. Excellent leadership, communication, and executive‑level presentation skills. Preferred Qualifications Salesforce certifications: Health Cloud Consultant, Life Sciences Cloud, or Architecture certifications. Experience working with large global pharma clients across multi‑brand and multi‑market programs. Exposure to AI‑driven, agentic, or automation‑led workflows in patient services or CRM ecosystems

responsibilities: Senior Talent Sourcer – Global Hiring About Talent Sourcing & Intelligence (TSI) The Talent Sourcing & Intelligence (TSI) team is a strategic global function that partners closely with Talent Acquisition and business leaders to identify, engage, and attract exceptional talent across consulting, technology, analytics, AI, life sciences, and corporate functions. Beyond sourcing, TSI drives market intelligence, talent mapping, competitor research, workforce insights, and leverages AI-powered recruiting technologies to enable smarter hiring decisions. As trusted advisors, we help shape talent strategies that support ZS’s global growth. Role Overview We are looking for a passionate, curious, and technology-savvy Senior Talent Sourcer to join our Global Talent Sourcing & Intelligence team. In this role, you will partner with recruiters and hiring managers to develop innovative sourcing strategies, build diverse talent pipelines, generate market intelligence, and leverage GenAI and AI-enabled recruiting tools to identify and engage world-class talent globally. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, uncovering hidden talent, and using data and technology to influence hiring decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Conduct industry research including talent availability, hiring trends, compensation benchmarking, competitor movement, and emerging skill landscapes. Partner with recruiters to define target talent personas and build long-term pipelines for critical and niche skill areas. Develop compelling candidate engagement strategies and employer branding initiatives to attract passive talent. Maintain accurate sourcing activity, talent insights, and pipeline data within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and CRM. Present sourcing insights and market intelligence to recruiters, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders. Support strategic hiring initiatives including new capability builds, leadership hiring, geographic expansion, and workforce planning projects. Champion continuous improvement by adopting emerging sourcing technologies, AI innovations, automation, and best practices. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a strong academic record. 4–6 years of experience in global talent sourcing, executive search research, talent intelligence, recruitment research, or corporate recruiting, with exposure to hiring across multiple geographies. Strong expertise in internet research, Boolean search, X-Ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms. Experience creating talent maps, competitor intelligence reports, and market research. Exposure to AI/GenAI recruiting platforms (e.g., LinkedIn AI, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, sourcing automation tools, talent intelligence platforms, CRM automation) is highly desirable. Strong analytical and research capabilities with the ability to translate market insights into actionable hiring recommendations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence engaging senior professionals globally. Ability to manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and recruitment systems (ATS/CRM). Curiosity, innovation mindset, and enthusiasm for leveraging technology to transform recruiting
